led_source: Direct 1P Bd15070_4IF RGB buttons plus three independent white FET channels. Separate original IO.Jvs.SetPwmOutput player 0 and DB.LedBlock Billboard_1P RGB commands; independent of Virtual Keyboard.
stats_source: Main-thread GameScoreList snapshots, NotesManager time, MusicData copied strings. Result snapshots retained until ResultProcess release. No managed calls from JNI.
ui_policy: Compact OFF once per game-data migration, then preserve user choices. External output temporarily hides the game Display UI CanvasGroup and disables its interaction/raycasts; exact original state restored on the game Update thread.
boot_source: Fresh controller edge presses the real startup Button on EventSystem.Update; manual start and held-input suppression share a one-shot gate. Startup readiness requires a visible main Canvas and an inactive processing UI (streaming download/conversion/cache); shared with deferred first-run setup.
aime_source: Validated physical 10-byte BCD access code, current original AimeUnit scanning window, original API.UseAimeUnitResult on Unity Update. Existing configured-server lookup and registration retained. No IDm conversion or fake card IDs.
aime_error_source: Issues 1..5 use a request-start scan generation token, current open scan and short-lived primitive queue. Unity Update sets existing verified AimeErrorInfo.Category=Warning(1), HasError=true and IsBusy=false while HasResult remains false. Original Manager Polling->Result reports Result.Error; TryAime/ErrorAime opens EntryErrorAimeUnknown(13). Fatal category is never fabricated. Only the next actual AimeUnitStart clears an adapter-owned warning. Successful cards require the same generation token; existing game/server results win races. AdvCheck preserves the original return unless the same adapter-owned warning reached manager Done(9)/Result.Error(4); this releases TryAime.WaitAdvCheck without creating a read result. AnyRead additionally exposes the same completed error as a read event only while original read/enable flags are set, allowing the original AdvertiseProcess.IsGotoEntry path and login-disable guard to enter the card screen.
aime_led_source: Capture AimeReaderManager.Execute status commands at the caller; Android AimeUnit LED setters are adjacent 4-byte RET stubs and are not patched. Palette from DebugUI.DebugLED: scan white, success blue, network warning FFEB04, error red; results expire after 3 seconds.
ceiling_patch: Exact 4-byte RET at IO.Jvs.SetPwmOutput is replaced by one aligned atomic AArch64 B to a range-checked mmap-hint trampoline. No MAP_FIXED; thunk is RW then RX, original code-page protections restored, adjacent functions unmodified. Failure disables ceiling capture only. Snapshot: status/events/seen + buttons0..7 + Body8/Circle9/Side10 + BillboardRGB11.
camera_policy: Experimental opt-in selected-facing camera adapter; front is the default, rear is explicit and changes apply on game restart. Android CAMERA permission and SkipPhotoCamera OFF required. Run real preflight, retain failures, then unlock local icon/memorial photo gates. No photo consent, user selection or server result is fabricated. CPU YUV conversion bypasses missing video shaders; normalized 1280x960 buffer and centered single-player crop. Live front-camera video, centered guide and square preview confirmed on 1.65. Mirroring is saved separately per lens (front ON, rear OFF by default) and latched on game startup; previews, profile-photo output and memorial photos use the same choice. The separate profile-save processes use the selected central region instead of P1/P2 quarter-width crops. Final saved-icon and rear-camera device validation pending.
